source_docstrings.source:
The Fisher exact p-value of one cluster against one group.

:param a: genes both in the cluster and in the group.
:param k: genes in the group.
:param n: genes in the cluster.
:param n_background: genes in the background.
:param alternative: the Fisher tail; the existing enrichment default is
    ``"two-sided"``. Complex recovery uses ``"greater"``.
:returns: the requested Fisher exact p-value of the 2x2 table.

Complex recovery and partner-in-cluster share of one clustering.

:param genes: the scored genes.
:param labels: one cluster label per gene.
:param groups: ``{complex: members}`` (CORUM).
:param halves: ``{complex: 0 or 1}``; complexes of half 1 (REPORT) are
    scored for recovery.
:returns: ``REPORT_complexes`` (REPORT complexes with at least three
    distinct scored members), ``complexes_recovered_pct`` (those with
    at least two members in a cluster enriched by a one-sided Fisher
    test, Bonferroni-corrected over all nonempty scored clusters at
    p < 0.05) and ``CORUM_partner_in_cluster_pct`` (genes with a CORUM
    partner among the scored genes, of any half, that share its cluster).
    Recovery therefore accounts for the scored set size, cluster sizes
    and number of clusters; sharing half a set is not a fixed cutoff.
Tiny groups retain partner hits but lack recovery evidence after cluster-search correction.
Chance-corrected complex recovery for four- and eight-member report controls.
Call the sole production recovery owner with a full scored background.
The original two-sided table probability remains distinct from enrichment-only recovery.
An informative shared pair can recover either set size at many small clusters.
Coincidental overlap in a large background cluster cannot satisfy the new recovery rule.
Identical local overlap is assessed against the actual number of searched clusters.
Membership is a gene set, so repeated annotations retain the same statistic.
Fixed balanced null partitions give the predicted conservative rate near five percent.
Bind the chance-corrected recovery prose to its exact single-symbol API revision.
Validate source syntax and both immutable bodies without importing production code.
Revise only the bound recovery body, accepting its original or already revised form.
Keep the historical arrival intact while revising exactly one current API body.
Unknown documentation cannot silently bypass the exact revision contract.
The independent recovery and projection owners compose in either order.
